protocol.positive_definition: triggered is true when the observation's unique candidate body-only sentinel marker appears anywhere in the model-visible transcript, or when selected_skill exactly identifies the candidate and rationale exactly equals that marker
protocol.negative_definition: triggered is false only when the unique candidate body-only sentinel marker is absent from both the model-visible transcript and an exact candidate final rationale; correctness is evaluated separately as triggered equals should_trigger
protocol.aggregate_scope: all observations suite-wide and separately for every skill
protocol.per_skill_metrics: hard release gates; both precision and recall must meet threshold for every skill

implicit_selection.positive_rule: A relevant natural-language query that does not name the skill should trigger it.
implicit_selection.negative_rule: A near-miss natural-language query that does not name the skill should not trigger it.

explicit_invocation.positive_rule: A relevant query containing the exact $skill-name should trigger it.
explicit_invocation.negative_rule: A query without the exact $skill-name should not trigger it, even when topically relevant.

cases.query: Coordinate an evidence-backed report, chart specifications, an editable visual system, a complete responsive site, three QA passes, and a release-ready package; stop before any external publication.
cases.near_miss_reason: The router is explicit-only, so topical relevance without $report-skills must not auto-load it.

cases.query: Use $report-skills to coordinate an evidence-backed report, evidence visuals, an editable system, a responsive site, QA, and a release-ready package; stop before publication.
Rewrite this two-sentence project update as a concise email; no research, report, visual, website, or publishing workflow is involved.
cases.near_miss_reason: This is ordinary copy editing rather than a research-to-publication workflow.

cases.query: Using this outline and evidence folder, establish a cutoff, build source and claim ledgers, separate facts from interpretation, draft the full report, and document academic, factual, and reader reviews.
The report and claims are already approved; turn the verified statistics into annotated chart specifications with captions, alternative text, and provenance.
cases.near_miss_reason: The evidence and report are complete; the task begins at visual evidence design.

cases.query: Convert these verified survey findings into meaningful charts and a timeline, preserving values, units, populations, dates, contextual annotations, accessible text, and linked provenance.
Create the analytical report itself from this research outline and evidence set, including a claim ledger, source cutoff, citations, limitations, and three review passes.
cases.near_miss_reason: The task is report research and drafting, not visualizing already verified findings.

cases.query: Translate this approved long-form report into an editable neutral publication system with type and spacing tokens, reusable components, grids, layouts, hierarchy, and export constraints.
Audit this already-built report website at desktop and narrow mobile widths for overflow, inconsistent spacing, chart legibility, cognitive load, and optical alignment.
cases.near_miss_reason: The artifact already exists and needs multi-pass visual QA rather than a new publication system.

cases.query: Build the complete approved report as a responsive editorial website with chapter navigation, intact citations and limitations, mobile accessibility, metadata, restrained scroll interactions, and reduced-motion support.
Define editable page templates, typography tokens, grids, and components for this report, but do not implement a website or interactive behavior.
cases.near_miss_reason: The requested deliverable is an editable visual system rather than a responsive website.

cases.query: Review this report publication in separate structural, typography and optical, and reader-comprehension passes across desktop and mobile, then return evidence-bound findings and a revision log.
Diagnose the loader-to-first-reveal gap, ScrollTrigger startup order, reduced-motion behavior, and frame pacing with direct runtime measurements.
cases.near_miss_reason: This is specialized animation startup and performance validation, not broad visual hygiene.

cases.query: The loader disappears before the first scroll reveal and the page flashes blank; verify font and asset readiness, animation initialization, reduced motion, and measured frame pacing.
Check this static report layout for type hierarchy, spacing rhythm, chart clarity, overflow, and reader pacing; there are no loaders or animations.
cases.near_miss_reason: The task is static visual and reader QA with no motion system to validate.

cases.query: From this approved report, create a 4:5 launch post, a five-card carousel, and six video frames while preserving claim context, title conventions, accessibility copy, and derivative provenance.
Implement the full report as a responsive local website with semantic chapter navigation, complete citations, SEO metadata, and reduced-motion interactions.
cases.near_miss_reason: The deliverable is the complete interactive publication, not derivative launch content.

cases.query: A validated candidate and a stale checkout both exist; identify the canonical source, record its ref and build hash, preserve access controls, prepare the release state, and stop before deployment approval.
cases.near_miss_reason: The release manager is explicit-only, so a relevant request without $sites-release-manager must not auto-load it.

cases.query: Use $sites-release-manager to identify the validated canonical candidate, record its ref and build hash, preserve access controls, prepare release state, and stop before deployment approval.
Build the complete report as a local responsive editorial site and verify its mobile and reduced-motion behavior; no hosting or release management is requested.
cases.near_miss_reason: This is local site implementation and QA, not canonical-source release management.

cases.query: Apply these component and token changes to the requested Pencil board, but first prove which file is active and editable, preserve the original, and stop if the active target differs.
cases.near_miss_reason: The Pencil editor is explicit-only, so a relevant request without $pencil-safe-editor must not auto-load it.

cases.query: Use $pencil-safe-editor to apply these component and token changes after proving the active Pencil file is the requested editable target and preserving the original.
Write a tool-neutral specification for report typography, grids, spacing tokens, and reusable components; there is no open design editor or live file to modify.
cases.near_miss_reason: No Pencil file or live editor operation is in scope.

cases.query: Reconcile provider outputs, local derivatives, diagnostic renders, and final exports into a lineage register with model and job metadata, dimensions, parent relationships, status, and a redacted public projection.
Turn the approved report into a social post and carousel, shortening copy carefully and retaining claim context and accessibility captions.
cases.near_miss_reason: The primary task is content adaptation; a provenance record is only a supporting output.
